resolution: The UV texture workflow now writes and verifies the live atlas before copying its absolute base.png path, so the editor no longer advertises a file that has not landed. The UV panel also imports PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP textures through the native picker at their own dimensions, preserves the current normalized UV map for immediate remapping, persists the imported raster as the model baseline, and restores that native size before the saved layout on reopen.
